column3: Manami Route ・ Bathtime Fun
*sigh*... Today sure was an awfully long day.
Manami's weird behavior, Kuroneko's thought-provoking words...
Oh well, I'm not in any rush...
It's not like it has anything to do with the fact that Kuroneko said it...
As for Manami, we've always been together, and it's to be expected that we'll stay together from now on as well...
No need to rush, right...? Manami thinks so too...
...Or does she?
Gaah, I can't make any sense of it. Anyway, time to take a bath and clear my head!
Fuaaaaah!! Baths sure are nice!
Not too hot, not even warm, but the water feels just right!
Aaaaaah, I sure am glad to be Japanese...!
Right now, all my worries from earlier are just drifting away...
Manami too...
Manami's probably entering her bath right now too.
Soaking in the bathtub, getting rid of stress... I hope she can relax and clear her head like I am...
Haaaa...
Really, what was up with Manami today...
Hmm?
Kyou-chan, how's the water?
Hu-HUUUH!?
Is it too hot?
No, it's quite good... That's not the point!
W-Why are you here?!
Is something wrong?
It's not a matter of right or wrong! This is MY bath in MY house!
Yes, your mom let me in. I also greeted your dad.
No, wait a second, t-that sound just now...?!
La la～
Manami... *gulp*, What are you doing right now?
Hmm? I'm here to wash your back... Here we go.
She's hereeeee! What's with this development?! Damnit, Manami, don't decide things on your own!
Oh? Are you already done...?
No, not yet.
Damn! Is this really the time to answer so obediently?!
Thank goodness.
Aw, this button got stuck...
Eh? B-Button?
Aww, Just wait a moment.... okay!
Ahhh! It finally came off, sorry to keep you waiting.
No, wait! Don't! Wait!
Don't wait? Great! Then... I'll wash your back.
Wait! It's fine, really, you don't have to!!
No need to be so embarrassed～
I'm not embarrassed! Seriously, Manami! What's wrong with you? You're acting so strange!
What's wrong? I'm totally fine with it!
I'm not! I mean... are you coming in...? Are you really coming in?!! I-I'm naked right now!! Also, you're naked too!
Yup. Because... we're taking a bath, right?
I know that! Which means... On the other side of the frosted glass, Manami is... Is she...?!
What's with this feeling?! Sure, we've taken plenty of baths together before but..! Even recently, I haven't thought of her in "that" way...
C-Can it be a part of the much-rumored "dating" thing!? Man, "dating" is awesome!
*gasp* This is not the time to think of that! Manami! Wai-, I said wait!
Aww, Kyou-chan, there's no need to be embarrassed, you know.
Waaaaaaaaaaa!!
*gasp*
Hmm... Huh...? Manami?
Ah, she's no longer here.
What I'm seeing is just my familiar ceiling.
Huh? W-What the?
I was taking a bath just then... Wasn't I?
Freshening up and all? ...What?
Ughhh...
My T-shirt is all sticky.
What... Was that... All a dream?
Oh well...
Today reaaaaaally was a loooooong day...
